stem: Select TWO actions that support this requirement: Using AWS services that improve the reliability of legacy applications and applications not built for the cloud (for example, when application changes are not possible)

choices.text: Design against the stated requirement and document tradeoffs
Validate with official documentation before applying
Store AWS access keys in the workbook git repo
Skip teardown if the instance is stopped
Use root credentials for every lab step

rationale: A and B are sound exam/lab practice. C/D/E violate credential, teardown, or root-user rules.
